title: QUIC server-side 0-RTT admission anti-replay gate work item
summary: Add the internal managed-server gate that must approve 0-RTT admission with validated PSK state, remembered transport-parameter acceptance, and listener-local one-time ticket consumption.
planned_changes:
- Add a listener-local early-data ticket-consumption path that removes a live ticket at most once.
- Add an internal server 0-RTT admission gate that requires prior PSK binder validation.
- Reuse the existing server remembered-transport-parameter policy before ticket consumption.
- Preserve normal 1-RTT resumption ticket lookup behavior.
- Keep early_data advertisement, server ZeroRtt packet opening, application delivery, public API widening, IsSupported changes, HTTP/3, and interop zerortt promotion out of scope.
- Add focused positive, negative, expiry, and fuzz-shaped requirement-home proof.
verification_plan: Run focused REQ_QUIC_CRT_0152 tests first, then SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release tests, and diff whitespace checks.
completion_notes: The managed server now has an internal 0-RTT admission gate that accepts only when the caller has already validated the PSK binder, the remembered transport parameters remain acceptable for server 0-RTT, and the listener-local ticket identity can be consumed exactly once. Unvalidated PSK offers and transport-parameter-rejected attempts fail without consuming the ticket. Expired, unknown, and replayed tickets fail closed. The slice does not advertise early_data, open server ZeroRtt packets, deliver early application data, widen public API or IsSupported, or promote the zerortt interop cell.
out_of_scope: server ZeroRtt packet opening or decryption
